# Code of conduct

Trunks Graph is a small project that welcomes everyone who wants to use it or help build it.

## What we expect

- Be respectful and patient, especially with people who are new to the project or to Git.
- Discuss ideas, not people. Disagree with care and assume good faith.
- Credit the work of others, and keep the project's clean-room rule
  ([`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md)).

## What is not accepted

- Harassment, insults or discriminatory language of any kind.
- Personal attacks, trolling or sustained disruption.
- Publishing anyone's private information without their permission.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may edit or remove comments, issues and pull requests that break this code, and may block anyone
who keeps breaking it. To report a problem privately, use GitHub's
[report content](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/maintaining-your-safety-on-github/reporting-abuse-or-spam)
feature, or open an issue asking the maintainer for a private contact, without giving details there.
